episodes.name: Meet the IQ
episodes.overviewEn: Eight-year-old genius inventor Tony Stark (aka Iron Man) gives a tour of the IQ.

episodes.name: Meet Iron Man
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man must rescue people from a Ferris wheel when it stops working.

episodes.name: Meet Ironheart
episodes.overviewEn: Ironheart, Iron Man, and Iron Hulk race to rescue a giant runaway donut in their Iron Racers.

episodes.name: Meet Iron Hulk
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Hulk helps rescue a kitten that's trapped in a tree.

episodes.name: Meet Iron Pup
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends must get Iron Pup's flying disc back after Absorbing Man steals it.

episodes.name: Meet Captain America
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man and Captain America work together when Swarm attacks the IQ with her robotic lightning bug.

episodes.name: Meet Iron Spider
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man and Iron Spider must save the pier when Swarm makes a mess of it with her robotic bugs.

episodes.name: Meet Black Panther
episodes.overviewEn: When Swarm uses her robotic slime bug to make a mess of Stark Expo, it's up to Iron Man and Black Panther to rescue the visitors and save the day.

episodes.name: Meet Ultron
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man must stop Ultron when he uses his robotic racer to steal things from people all over town.

episodes.name: Meet Vision
episodes.overviewEn: When the training bots go out of control in the Smashcade, Iron Man needs Vision's help to get everything back in working order.

episodes.name: Giant Size Iron Friends
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends use their new giant-sized armor.

episodes.name: Iron Jet-Setting
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends use their Iron Jet to defeat Swarm.

episodes.name: The Mighty Thor
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man and Ironheart build Thor a new car.

episodes.name: Gigantic Giant-Man
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man and Giant-Man help build a monorail.

episodes.name: Ultron Goes Giant-Sized
episodes.overviewEn: Ultron has new giant-sized armor.

episodes.name: Hawkeyes Can't Fly
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man and Hawkeye train in the Smashcade.

episodes.name: Lunch with Loki
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man and Iron Hulk stop Loki on the pier.

episodes.name: The Cap Cycle
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man and Captain America stop Absorbing Man.

episodes.name: The Flying Panther
episodes.overviewEn: Black Panther helps Iron Man and Ironheart stop Swarm.

episodes.name: Rock N Roll Starks
episodes.overviewEn: Ultron interrupts Tony and his dad's band performance.
